text: Grandson, 3 months old, temp 38.1. He's got a red rash on his body but it goes pale when I press a glass on it, I've checked it twice. He's also got some red bumps on his legs and arms, and those are mosquito bites from lying on a blanket in the garden all afternoon, his mum was bitten too. His neck is fine, he looks down at his feet no problem. No fits, no shaking or jerking. Does he need to be seen tonight or not. A straight answer please.
